live_join.sampling_frame: Live join is SUCCESS-receipt evidence[] only. command-center/adversarial exists but those files are not claim-level Sherman-Kent band + refuter-verdict rows, so they are not joined. command-center/confirmation exists but those files are not claim-level Sherman-Kent band + confirmer-verdict rows, so they are not joined. A frame with no REFUTED class cannot answer whether 'likely' meant 55-80 percent in practice for the program. The synthetic-perfect arm validates the scorer, not the estate.

program_verdict.note: Live join is SUCCESS-receipt evidence[] only. command-center/adversarial exists but those files are not claim-level Sherman-Kent band + refuter-verdict rows, so they are not joined. command-center/confirmation exists but those files are not claim-level Sherman-Kent band + confirmer-verdict rows, so they are not joined. A frame with no REFUTED class cannot answer whether 'likely' meant 55-80 percent in practice for the program. The synthetic-perfect arm validates the scorer, not the estate.

question: Question: were the confidence bands used across the program calibrated? Target: join every banded claim to its later verification outcome and compute hit-rate per band plus an overall proper score, so the report can state whether 'likely' meant 55-80 percent in practice. The measured estate precedent is stark -- agents self-rated high confidence on 89 percent of findings while 42 percent of those checked were REFUTED.
sentinel: SUCCESS:SYN-0035 emitted only when the artifact at output_path exists, is non-empty, parses against output_schema, and every band row states n and the unadjudicated count is reported separately. Any other terminal state is FAILED:SYN-0035 <classification> with the diagnostic tail attached.

signals.confirmer_verdicts: Live: evidence[].verdict on SUCCESS receipts (CONFIRMED|REFUTED adjudicate; NOT-CHECKED|BLOCKED|PARTIAL excluded and counted). Synthetic: planted confirmer_verdict is the simulated Phase 11/12 outcome. B10 adversarial receipts are absent.
signals.mutation_oracle: Synthetic oracle_label is planted in fixtures.py and is never consulted by hit-rate or Brier. Live rows have oracle_label=null; confirmer_verdict is not copied into oracle (imputed-outcome forbidden).
